knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=A list of matrices representing cell populations per sample, where rows are cells, columns are markers, and values are intensities (only cells expressing >=1 marker) ;; counts=A named integer vector of total recovered cells per sample ;; meta=A data.frame of metadata associating sample IDs with individual IDs and covariates ;; treatment=A logical vector or expression identifying stimulated samples ;; control=A logical vector or expression identifying unstimulated/control samples ;; iterations=Number of MCMC iterations (default 400,000 for full run, lower for testing) ;; replications=Number of MCMC replications in SimpleCOMPASS (default 8 for full run) ;; n_s=Matrix of stimulated cell counts (samples as rows, boolean cell subsets as columns) ;; n_u=Matrix of unstimulated cell counts (samples as rows, boolean cell subsets as columns) ;; individual_id=Column name in metadata identifying the unique individual/subject
- alternatives: flowWorkspace / openCyto=Used for managing and generating gates; COMPASS can interoperate with them via COMPASSContainerFromGatingSet to automatically extract data from a GatingSet instead of manually building a COMPASSContainer ;; SimpleCOMPASS()=Preferred when working directly with tabular cell count data (e.g., exported from FlowJo) rather than Bioconductor GatingSet objects, though it requires manual formatting of boolean cell subsets
- when_to_use: When analyzing multi-parameter single-cell data (like ICS flow cytometry) to identify antigen-specific T-cell subsets and quantify polyfunctionality while regularizing small cell counts.
- pitfalls: Inputting proportions instead of cell counts; COMPASS and SimpleCOMPASS require integer cell counts ;; Failing to ensure the last column of the count matrices in SimpleCOMPASS corresponds to the all-negative boolean cell subset ;; Mismatched row names or ordering between n_s, n_u, and meta in SimpleCOMPASS ;; Using too few iterations/replications for final analysis (vignette uses 100 or 1000 for speed, but 400,000 iterations and 8 replications are recommended for a complete run) ;; Not translating marker names to a COMPASS-compatible format (e.g., using & and ! instead of +/- or other custom formats)

workflows.name: standard_compass
workflows.intent: Fit a COMPASS model to cell-level marker intensity data using a COMPASSContainer and extract functionality scores.
input: data.rds (list of cell-level marker intensity matrices)
counts.rds (named integer vector of total cell counts)
workflows.stages: 1. Construct a COMPASSContainer using COMPASSContainer() ;; 2. Fit the COMPASS model using COMPASS() ;; 3. Extract functionality and polyfunctionality scores using FunctionalityScore() and PolyfunctionalityScore() ;; 4. Extract posterior probabilities using Posterior() ;; 5. Visualize results using plot() with different measures (PosteriorDiff(), PosteriorLogDiff())
workflows.code:
CC <- COMPASSContainer(
  data=data,
  counts=counts,
  meta=meta,
  individual_id="iid",
  sample_id="sid"
)
fit <- COMPASS( CC,
  treatment=trt == "Treatment",
  control=trt == "Control",
  iterations=100
)
FS <- FunctionalityScore(fit)
PFS <- PolyfunctionalityScore(fit)
post <- Posterior(fit)
plot(fit)
plot(fit, measure=PosteriorDiff(fit), threshold=0)
plot(fit, measure=PosteriorLogDiff(fit), threshold=0)

workflows.name: simple_compass
workflows.intent: Fit a COMPASS model directly to tabular cell count data of boolean combinations using SimpleCOMPASS.
input: SimpleCOMPASSExamples.csv (CSV file containing metadata and counts for boolean cell subsets)
workflows.stages: 1. Read and format tabular data, separating metadata and counts ;; 2. Split counts into stimulated (n_s) and unstimulated (n_u) matrices ;; 3. Format and translate marker names to COMPASS-compatible boolean format using COMPASS:::translate_marker_names() ;; 4. Ensure the last column is the all-negative combination ;; 5. Fit the model using COMPASS::SimpleCOMPASS() ;; 6. Extract and plot scores using scores() and plot()
workflows.code:
compass_data = read.csv(example_data_path, check.names=FALSE)
metadata = compass_data[,2:4]
metadata = as.data.frame(metadata)
counts = as.matrix(compass_data[,5:261])
counts = counts[,-1L] 
metadata$Stimulation[typos] = "Unstimulated"
n_u = subset(counts, metadata$Stimulation == "Unstimulated")
n_s = subset(counts, metadata$Stimulation == "ESAT6/CFP10")
metadata$unique_id = metadata$`PATIENT ID`
rownames(n_u) = subset(metadata$unique_id,
       metadata$Stimulation=="Unstimulated")
rownames(n_s) = subset(metadata$unique_id,
       metadata$Stimulation=="ESAT6/CFP10")
metadata = subset(metadata,
       metadata$Stimulation=="ESAT6/CFP10")
nms = basename(colnames(n_s))
nms = COMPASS:::translate_marker_names(nms)
colnames(n_s) = nms
nms = basename(colnames(n_u))
nms = COMPASS:::translate_marker_names(nms)
colnames(n_u) = nms
colnames(n_s) = rename_cytokines(colnames(n_s))
colnames(n_u) = rename_cytokines(colnames(n_u))
fit = COMPASS::SimpleCOMPASS(n_s = n_s,
                       n_u = n_u, 
                       meta = metadata,
                       individual_id = "unique_id",
                       iterations = 1000,
                       replications = 3)
scores(fit) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA) +
  geom_jitter() +
  aes(y = FS, x = GROUP)
plot(fit,"GROUP")
